title: Sekai Modded Survival
description: This is a Minecraft Survival Multiplayer server featuring a wide variety of mods, built on the concept of an equal community with no absolute authority.
body:
This is a Minecraft Survival Multiplayer server is itended to be "Forever Multiplayer World", featuring a wide variety of mods built on the concept of an *equal community with no absolute authority*.\
**“All players are equal, and decisions are made through majority discussion.”**

**Tired of the “2-week Minecraft phase”?**\
This server is designed to let players truly enjoy Minecraft together, allowing the server to last much longer by implementing mods that keep the world “alive” and offer many things to explore and learn.

**Is this "Kitchen Sink" modpack?**\
No, the server is focused on "Vanillaist" mods that not heavily change so many aspects and feel like vanilla aesthetics and being driven by community itself.
